answer: Here the defense prices each identity with a deposit refundable only after a cooling period, paid in scarce compute rather than free keys. An attacker minting a thousand clones must lock that stake for every one of them, so the bill scales linearly while influence per clone stays flat. Caught farms forfeit the whole deposit, like timber burned rather than compounded. Value erodes while staked, so hoarded identities age into a dull umber and stop paying, while reputation earned from verified work survives as the asset a farm cannot mass-produce, settling slowly like velvet worn in over years.
